extracted.intended_audience: members of the media, journalists, and the general public seeking FAA news and resources
extracted.subtask_description: Navigating the Federal Aviation Administration's Newsroom to find press releases, statements, fact sheets, speeches, testimony, and contact procedures for media inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Office Contact Information
rubrics_metrics.description: We cover the press box from 7:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on weekdays and periodically on weekends. Please email inquiries to pressoffice@faa.gov along with your deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include your deadline when emailing the press office; contact window is weekdays 7:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET and sometimes weekends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsroom Content Categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Newsroom organizes communications into categories: Press Releases; Statements; General Statements; Accidents/Incidents; Fact Sheets; Speeches; Current Officials; Former Officials; Testimony; Conferences & Events; Daily Air Traffic Report; Flight Delay Information; FAA Safety Briefing Magazine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these categories to locate the type of FAA communication you need (e.g., press release vs. testimony vs. fact sheet).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Resources (available reference materials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Media resources listed include: FAA statements on Aviation Accidents and Incidents; Flight Delay Information; FAA Fact Book (facts, data, and graphics about FAA's management of airspace); Airport Operations and Ranking Reports from the Air Traffic Activity Data System (ATADS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These resources provide background data, facts, and graphics useful for reporting or preparing inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Government Interest (SGI) process — drone permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Request permission to operate a drone in an area with temporary flight restrictions (Special Government Interest (SGI) process).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the SGI process when seeking authorization for drone operations in temporarily restricted areas; refer to the Newsroom link for the procedural details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fact Sheets (topics and examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Newsroom provides fact sheets on specific topics (examples listed with dates): 'Restricting Drones Near Critical Infrastructure Sites' (May 6, 2026); 'Engineered Material Arresting System (EMAS)' (April 24, 2026); 'How it Works: Aircraft Certification' (April 23, 2026); 'The eIPP: What You Need to Know' (March 9, 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fact sheets summarize programs, processes, and technical topics — useful for quick background or to cite authoritative FAA descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archived Speeches and Testimony
rubrics_metrics.description: The site archives speeches and congressional testimony with dates and titles (examples: 'Pre-Thanksgiving Press Conference' Nov 21, 2024; 'FAA Drone and AAM Symposium Remarks' July 30, 2024; multiple testimonies before Congressional committees in 2024–2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use archived speeches and testimony to find official remarks and positions; entries include dates and hearing/committee context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media and Subscription Channels
rubrics_metrics.description: FAA links to social media and subscription channels: Visit the FAA Facebook Page; Follow us on @FAANews; View FAA on Instagram; Connect with FAA on LinkedIn; Watch FAA's YouTube Channel; FAA's Cleared for Takeoff Blog; Subscribe to FAA News.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow or subscribe to these channels to receive timely updates, press releases, and multimedia content.
